baseline_runs.answer:
Here are a few options, all low-key and including the invoice number:

- Invoice #4471 for October Design Work
- Invoice #4471 – October Design Services
- Your October Invoice (#4471)
- Invoice #4471 for Your Records
- October Design Work – Invoice #4471 Attached

The last one or "Invoice #4471 for Your Records" are probably the gentlest options.

Here are a few options that are low-key and include the invoice number:

- Invoice #4471 for October Design Work
- October Design Work – Invoice #4471
- Invoice #4471 Attached
- Following Up: Invoice #4471 for October Design

The first or second would work well for a gentle, professional tone.

Here are a few options, all low-key and including the invoice number:

- Invoice #4471 for October Design Work
- Invoice #4471 – October Design Services
- Your October Invoice (#4471)
